text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart sprinted through her first 
three years— her youth—with everything she 
had.
And so—those days are still far from over.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In the lead is Daiwa Scarlet! Daiwa 
Scarlet takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—This year's Tiara Umamusume truly is 
strong! Daiwa Scarlet! She has triumphed 
against her formidable seniors!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fufun! 'Cause I'm number one!
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: —That was insane! Daiwa Scarlet...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
For real~! Super strong! Man, what with 
Vodka winning the Japan Derby and all, the 
Tiara route is on fire this year too!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, about that race... 
Daring Heart was in a pretty good position 
too, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's true...! The final result was 
disappointing, but there were moments that 
made you go 'Whoa!'

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see... Daring Heart... She's still 
giving it her all out there, huh.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
—Her generation was intense too, wasn't 
it? Rhein Kraft, Cesario, Air Messiah was 
there as well...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I was there in person for that Oka Sho! 
Man, the passion in the air was just 
insane...!

—With her own legs, Daring Heart... 
connects the days of her youth to the 
present.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
12th place... That's awful! That's quite a 
crushing defeat.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
On the final stretch, it just became too 
painful... I couldn't run properly at all.
choice_data_list:
Still, you didn't give up until the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! Naturally! Even if I run 
completely out of breath—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I still have this heart of mine. I will do 
the absolute best I can at that moment!

Daring Heart will never give up. Even if 
she's past her prime... she'll run 
straight through with her "daring heart."

"...Even so, simply being able to keep 
running is not enough. Why? Because she 
is—an Umamusume capable of winning."
choice_data_list: ...I have a bit of a suggestion, though—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Switching to dirt for the next race... 
You sure come up with some wild ideas."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Our goal has always been turf. ...You 
haven't just thrown in the towel, have 
you?
choice_data_list: Of course, there's a good reason for it.

text_block_list.text:
"Dirt racing basically favors 
front-runners. Since it's harder to build 
up speed, there are many cases where an 
Umamusume who takes the lead goes on to 
win outright."
choice_data_list:
You can play directly to your strengths, 
and at the same time—

You can play directly to your strengths, 
while at the same time—

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume running on dirt for the first 
time often flinch at the sharpness of the 
gravel. Because of that, some fail to 
transition. But she—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I fear nothing. Because I am... "Daring 
Heart."
choice_data_list:
Next time we'll win and make your presence 
known.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
... You really know how to flatter me and 
get me fired up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay! Let's show everyone one more time, 
shall we?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That Daring Heart keeps charging forward 
boldly— and that she's the absolute best 
queen around!

Yes, Daring Heart takes on the challenge. 
The world she lives in is always the front 
line... A harsh battle for survival.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Listen up! I just had an amazing idea! 
The ultimate way to enjoy our next race to 
the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Can I try it in our next training 
session? If it goes well, we might just 
spark an intense showdown!"

I gaze at Daring Heart. Her eyes are 
always shining with vibrant life— focused 
solely and intently on her "now."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ? What's wrong? You're zoning out.
choice_data_list:
For you... it has to be "right now," 
doesn't it?

For you, it really has to be... 'now,' 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course—I will live in the 
present! From now on, always.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You love that about me too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu! —I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...! Haaaaaaaaaaaa...!! Not yet, not 
yettt...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I want to be... just like Heart-san. 
With that strong, unwavering heart—

Daring Heart keeps taking on the 
challenge. That brave heart becomes a 
seed—
In some future, someday—it will bloom.
And—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just a tiny bit late... ...Wait, 
you're the only one here?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, that's right! You're the first to 
arrive, Cesario!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'm late...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I planned on arriving earlier, but... I 
got so caught up in putting together 
strategy notes for everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, you're fine, Messiah! I love how 
fired up you are!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well... Now then, I wonder when our 
sleepyhead will get here?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Everyooone~~! I'm so sorryâ¦â¦!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I was working so hard on my warm-up that 
before I knew it, time was up...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, I understand, Craft. You were 
looking forward to this too, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Because... I wanted to run!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry to keep you waiting, Heart-san! 
Let's run together!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Let's run—all of us together!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaaaaah...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heheheh! I won't lose...!!
Daring Heart's youth is far from over.

"Because if they feel that fun-loving 
'Daring Heart'— it'll reawaken the passion 
in anyone."
